Tired of your AI coding assistant forgetting context, hitting token limits, or making messy mistakes on multi-step tasks? 

Meet ECC (https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC), the ultimate agent harness optimization system designed to supercharge tools like Claude Code and Cursor. ECC introduces a coordinated operating system packed with persistent memory, autonomous planning, and self-verification loops so you can stop babysitting your AI.

The Problem:
AI coding assistants often lack a rigorous engineering lifecycle. They jump straight into coding without planning, blow past context windows during long refactors, and fail to verify their own work properly.

How ECC Fixes It:
ECC gives your AI agents a complete, structured development workflow. It forces the assistant to plan before building, verify with tests, run self-reviews from a fresh context, and even convert successful workflows into reusable skills for the future.

Key Features Built for Power Users:
- Massive Agent & Skill Ecosystem: Features 71 specialized agents (for planning, architecture, security, and build repair) and 311 skills covering TDD, docs, frontend, and machine learning.
- Autonomous Engineering Loop: Handles planning, testing, implementation, review, verification, and memory retention automatically.
- Multi-Harness Compatibility: Deep native support for Claude Code, Codex, and Qoder, plus adapters for Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini, Zed, and GitHub Copilot.
- AgentShield Security Guardrails: Protects your codebase against vulnerabilities and unsafe agent executions.

Whether you are managing complex long-running refactoring tasks or enforcing strict Test-Driven Development (TDD) loops, ECC dramatically reduces context exhaustion and erratic AI behavior.

Ready to give your AI coding assistant a massive upgrade? 

Check out the repo, star it, and install it today:
https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC

When media platforms constantly shift their infrastructure, yt-dlp remains the ultimate battle-tested, feature-rich extraction engine for robust video and audio downloading. 🎥⚡

Building scraping pipelines or gathering data for AI training shouldn't mean constantly rewriting fragile web scrapers. This command-line utility and Python library serves as the heavily extended, actively maintained successor to youtube-dl, solving the headache of brittle media ingestion.

Here is why developers and data engineers rely on it:
🔹 Massive Platform Support: Extract content from thousands of distinct media platforms with rapid patching for breaking changes and site updates.
🔹 Advanced Format Selection: Utilize precise sorting algorithms for fine-grained control over resolution, codecs, and container types.
🔹 Automated Post-Processing: Embed subtitles, chapters, and thumbnails natively, or integrate seamlessly with SponsorBlock.
🔹 Python API & Plugin Architecture: Embed it directly into your applications or extend it with custom extractors for complex workflows.

Whether you are automating large-scale dataset harvesting for machine learning or archiving historical video streams with custom metadata tagging, yt-dlp handles the edge cases so you don't have to.

Check out the repository and level up your media pipelines today:
https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp

Tired of your smart TV serving up laggy ads and telemetry instead of content? 📺😡

Modern streaming devices have turned into surveillance and ad-delivery systems. If you want true local control over your hardware without breaking a sweat—or your warranty—meet dumbtv.

It is a non-destructive, script-based toolkit designed to clean up Amazon Fire TV devices over ADB completely without requiring root access. 

Here is what dumbtv solves for you:
• Strips out intrusive sponsored content, ads, and tracking
• Disables roughly 50 unnecessary bloatware packages safely
• Runs an on-device DNS filter to stop data harvesting in its tracks
• Replaces the bloated stock launcher with a lightning-fast, permissionless home screen

Notable Features:
🔧 Non-root ADB management that safely disables ad and telemetry services rather than forcing risky deletions.
🛡️ Built-in on-device DNS filtering powered by personalDNSfilter, blocking over 400 telemetry domains without breaking your core apps.
⚡ A custom, ultra-lightweight home screen launcher written in plain Java with zero internet permissions or external libraries.
🎛️ Interactive preflight checks and modular scripts letting you selectively keep or drop features like Prime Video or Alexa.

For developers and system engineers, dumbtv serves as an incredible reference implementation for automated Android device management, smart ADB scripting, and non-root system debloating. Whether you are provisioning multiple streaming sticks in a homelab or studying low-overhead native Android launchers, this repo is worth a deep dive.

Check out the code and reclaim your living room hardware today:
https://github.com/humblemuzzu/dumbtv

Unlock the power of AI coding agents to reverse engineer binaries, legacy codebases, and proprietary protocols with precision prompts. 🚀

Enter JoasASantos/REA-Prompts, a game-changing curated collection of specialized prompt-engineering strategies designed to guide AI coding agents through deep reverse-engineering tasks safely and systematically.

Here is what makes it a must-have in your toolkit:
🔍 Evidence-backed analysis prompts that force AI agents to cite file paths, functions, memory addresses, or code snippets for every conclusion.
🌐 Comprehensive coverage across native binaries, feature tracing, game mechanics recovery, and protocol extraction.
🛡️ Clean-room cloning frameworks that help extract behavior and specifications without copying proprietary source code or assets.
⚠️ Built-in safeguards emphasizing responsible security research, bug bounties, and interoperability testing.

Whether you are tracing data flows, documenting proprietary wire formats, or auditing security on authorized targets, this toolset cuts traditional analysis times down to a fraction.

🚨 CRITICAL SECURITY ALERT: New Pre-Auth RCE Vulnerabilities in PHP 🚨

Are your PHP servers prepared for the latest core engine threats? Discover how the critical php2shell vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) impact the PHP ecosystem and how this toolkit provides exploit verification and comprehensive multi-layer detection rules.

The Problem:
This project provides a comprehensive proof-of-concept, exploitation, and defensive detection toolkit for CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, a pair of critical pre-authentication Remote Code Execution vulnerabilities affecting PHP's session upload progress mechanism and the Zend engine core across multiple major versions.

Key Features & Capabilities:
🔥 Multi-chain exploitation framework demonstrating five independent RCE vectors ranging from session injection and LFI to use-after-free and Zend engine OOM memory corruption.
🛡️ Comprehensive detection rule suite containing production-ready signatures for Suricata, Snort, Sigma SIEM, ModSecurity WAF, and OpenResty Lua reverse proxies.
🐳 Isolated testing lab utilizing Docker Compose with pre-configured vulnerable PHP environments across different SAPI configurations like PHP-FPM, Nginx, and Apache mod_php.
🔍 Targeted verification scripts allowing security engineers and administrators to safely test specific attack chains without executing full disruptive exploits.

Developer & SecOps Value:
AppSec engineers, pentesters, and sysadmins can use this repository to understand deeply how low-level memory corruption and session state mismanagement can bypass high-level application logic. By deploying the included lab environment and WAF or IDS rules, teams can validate their stack's resilience, test patching efficacy across PHP 8.2, 8.3, 8.4, and 8.5, and implement immediate mitigations before broader automated exploitation occurs.

👉 Check out the repository here: https://github.com/ikow/php2shell-poc
